modified.oldDescription: Execute independent read-only bridge calls in parallel to reduce round-trips. Mutations and destructive reads are rejected; run them sequentially with specialized tools or browser_call. Preserves call order in the response.
modified.newDescription: Execute independent read-only bridge calls in parallel to reduce round-trips. Mutations and destructive reads are rejected; for known ordered actions use browser_call method input.perform instead. Preserves call order in the response.

modified.oldDescription: Primary Browser Bridge tool for permission-ask hosts: call any bridge method directly by name so the user can approve one BBX MCP tool instead of each specialized tool separately.
modified.newDescription: Call any bridge method by name through one approvable MCP tool. For known authorized multi-step flows, use input.perform with returnLastResult: true to run input, waits, and a final bounded read in one call. Stop for decisions requiring new evidence or approval; never blindly replay a partial flow.

scope: Versions supported by npm archive metadata, integrity checks and static exact full description matches. No new MCP execution.
